subject.title: fix(media): accept repeated content-length when values match

question: Should OpenClaw accept the plugin-visible `parseMediaContentLength` behavior broadening for identical repeated Content-Length values?
rationale: The PR is a narrow bug fix backed by RFC behavior, but the helper is exported through the plugin SDK media runtime, so accepting the changed semantics is a maintainer-owned compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept Shared Parser Broadening
options.body: Approve the exported helper accepting identical repeated Content-Length values while preserving rejection of malformed, unsafe, empty, and conflicting values.

options.title: Keep Strict SDK Semantics
options.body: Ask for the PR to avoid changing the exported helper and instead handle only a narrower internal caller path, at the cost of duplicated policy.

options.title: Pause For API Direction
options.body: Hold the PR until a plugin/API owner decides whether this parser behavior should be part of the public media runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Parser Broadening
recommendation.body: Approve the exported helper accepting identical repeated Content-Length values while preserving rejection of malformed, unsafe, empty, and conflicting values.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current shared media helper, caller boundary, and plugin SDK export in the current main history.
